name: voracious_greatshark_counters_only_its_target
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Flash. When this creature enters, counter target artifact or creature spell.' Seat 0 casts Goldvein Pick (an artifact spell) and, holding priority, Spectral Sailor (a creature spell with flash), then Voracious Greatshark. The Greatshark resolves first; its trigger targets the Sailor and counters it alone: the Pick, not targeted, resolves onto the battlefield.
